However, the agency offered two specific comments requesting that the discussion of alternatives be expanded with a map of airport noise contours, and that borrow material be addressed including reclamation of borrow sites and potential use of excess material for noise barriers.

statement.text:
We have completed our review of the Draft Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) for the construction of an airport sput connecting 1-94 to General Mitchell Field in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. We have classified our comments as Category LO-1. Specifically, this means we have no objections to the project and we believe the EIS provides sufficient information to make this determination. This classification and the date of our comments will be published in the Federal Register in accordance with our responsibility to inform the public of our views on Federal actions under Section 309 of the Clean Air Act. We offer the following comments:
The discussion of alternatives should be expanded by including a map of the airport noise contours. Total noise exposure in the airport vicinity may be a factor in evaluating the various alternate corridors.
Borrow material should be discussed. If borrow will be required, the location and reclamation of borrow sites should be described. If excess borrow will be generated by the project, consideration should be given to utilizing this material to construct noise barriers at selected locations along 1-94 and the airport spur.
Thank you for providing us with the opportunity to review this Draft Environmental Impact Statement.
